workstream: Wave 3C-1 — Public infrastructure/facility completeness from Makati publications
closureRule: A facility family is complete only where the reviewed sources provide a defensible current named set or a named historical set that can be reconciled to current Makati. Headline-only counts are dispositioned but not converted into speculative pins.

notes: All 18 verified current MHD health-center sites are mapped.
Palanan 24/7 is a service designation at Palanan Health Center, not a duplicate physical asset.
Eight health centers in transferred barangays remain historical/former-Makati provenance and are excluded.
Barangay San Lorenzo's current medical/dental clinic system is verified but is not used to inflate the official MHD 18-center denominator.
The Makati Health Department employee clinic at City Hall is a specialized/internal clinic and is not counted as a community health-center asset.
All 11 current named stations are mapped.
West Rembo and Comembo fire stations are former-Makati and excluded.
A separate map feature labeled New Makati Central Fire Station is held from the current layer until its operational relationship to the officially listed central station is clear.
Current headquarters plus Sub-Stations 1–7 are mapped.
Transferred Sub-Stations 8 and 9 are blocked from current Makati.
Historical Precinct 10 in Rizal is preserved only as a former-Makati legacy record from the older inventory.
